entities.name: Hrafn Gunnlaugsson

entities.summary: Hrafn Gunnlaugsson is an Icelandic film director. He is mostly known for his series of Viking films, sometimes called "Cod Westerns". He won the award for Best Director at the 20th Guldbagge Awards for When the Raven Flies.
